scope: Sequential valid-grant direct indexed-engine lifecycle; two synthetic tenants, injected memory-idempotent providers, controlled lost acknowledgments. Acceptance tests separately exercise OAuth, HTTP and SDK MCP.

measurement.cpu: Process user+system delta per sequential request; includes SQLite/fsync and test adapters
measurement.latency: saveTurn/receive/claim/propose/tick/read incl controlled immediate retry, not SMS delivery or agent inference
measurement.io: Linux /proc/self/io process counter deltas; native SQLite included; write_bytes is kernel accounting, not exact database amplification or storage device flush bytes
measurement.storage: Physical SQLite/WAL/shared-memory file sizes before and after WAL checkpoint; index/page overhead included
measurement.memory: Sampled whole-process RSS; maximum observed, not continuous peak or per-tenant allocation
measurement.idle: 50 engine and notification sweeps over retained completed work; no configured notification routes

limitations: Single local Node process, no distributed/multi-host throughput claim
Sequential attribution does not measure concurrent per-tenant CPU
Process IO counters include incidental runtime activity and depend on filesystem/kernel accounting
Mock provider receipts use an in-memory map in this sampler; crash tests use durable engine records and separate fixtures
Different runtime/storage from previous JSON sample; observations do not establish a controlled hardware comparison
